name: Sofa Bed
description:
Family of three with a young daughter residing in a rental flat requires a sofa bed to replace their existing worn-out sofa. Both parents are currently experiencing employment instability and financial difficulties, with their limited income going towards household expenses and outstanding debts.

A sofa bed in good and usable condition would provide the family with a comfortable space for seating and resting. The family would greatly appreciate assistance with delivery due to their financial constraints.

name: Bicycle
description: Client is married with three children, aged 15, 13 and 2. He was recently laid off from his logistics job due to a lack of projects and is in the midst of changing employment. His wife is also looking for suitable part-time employment that would allow her to balance work with caring for their 2-year-old child. While awaiting suitable employment opportunities, client intends to undertake GrabFood/Foodpanda delivery by bicycle as an interim source of income to contribute towards the family's household expenses.
